items.title: Four Continents, Four New AWS Heroes: Closing Out 2026
items.summary: As AWS re:Invent is around the corner, we’re proud to recognize a new group of AWS Heroes. Every Hero finds their own way to give back, whether through sharing what they know, bringing people together, or building tools that help others succeed.
